title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
why_read: A real-world case study of AI chatbot content being reported to law enforcement raises serious questions about privacy, liability, and AI safety design that engineers building similar systems should understand.
analysis: This story describes an incident where Anthropic apparently flagged user-generated content (a diary-like entry) to police, leading to a criminal charge against the person who wrote it.
